name: financial-intel
description: Fixed five-call, read-only crypto market-research bundle across Alchemy, CoinGecko, Alpha Vantage, Nansen, and Exa. Requires coherent asset, benchmark, chain, and news inputs; every step is paid independently through the SELAT Router over x402 or MPP.

symbol.description: Crypto token symbol without $, e.g. ETH, for the Alchemy spot-price lookup.

coin.description: CoinGecko coin ID for the same asset, e.g. ethereum for ETH.

ticker.description: US equity or ETF ticker used only as an explicit market benchmark, e.g. QQQ or SPY.

assetChain.description: Nansen-supported data chain for chain-level smart-money holdings, e.g. ethereum or solana. This is not a settlement-chain flag.

query.description: Asset-specific current-news query, e.g. Ethereum ETH ETF flows regulation August 2026.

steps.label: spot price — Alchemy (x402 via Circle Gateway)
token market data — CoinGecko coins-markets (MPP on Tempo)
equity benchmark quote — Alpha Vantage global-quote (MPP on Tempo)
chain-level smart-money holdings — Nansen (MPP on Tempo)
news and market context — Exa search (MPP on Tempo)
